text: {"name": "txpacket_apply_cal_value", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Fetches a per-station 10-bit calibration value from a TX packet descriptor and applies or inspects it across four packet words using check_packet_bits when the value is valid and the global state permits.", "subsystem": "mac", "var_renames": {"result": "tx_desc", "v1": "cal_value", "v2": "sta_ctx_base", "v3": "word_iter", "v5": "word_ptr"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 28, "meaning": "uint8_t station or context index"}, {"offset": 72, "meaning": "packed uint64 containing packet/context pointers used to locate packet words and a bit table"}, {"offset": 1222, "meaning": "uint16_t per-station calibration value (0x3ff often denotes invalid/unset)"}]}
